'''MMV-608''' was a tracked [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] from the [[MMV security droid]] series. MMV-608 was active and protecting the mines of [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].

Its value was estimated in 20,000 credits.
